name: Initia iUSD
oneLiner: iUSD is an Initia wrapper backed 1:1 by bridged Agora AUSD; holders receive no reserve yield, and the Initia Bridge converts withdrawals through AUSD into USDC.

dependencyReview.reviewer: Codex Safety Score V9 NR-recovery wave 3
dependencyReview.rationale: Initia's reviewed vault and AUSD0 OFT resources establish that every iUSD is minted 1:1 against deposited AUSD0, the Initia representation of Agora AUSD. The complete holder claim therefore propagates serially from AUSD, while the local vault, OFT, LayerZero, and Initia controls remain wrapper-local risks.

relationships.reason: Every iUSD unit is a direct 1:1 wrapper claim on AUSD0 deposited in the Initia iusd-vault.

collateral: 1:1 backing in Agora AUSD bridged to Initia via LayerZero. Agora's August 2026 reserve report identifies Agora Bermuda Limited as the AUSD issuer and Agora Reserve Fund LP as its reserve-asset structure.
pegMechanism: iUSD expands when users deposit and contracts when they withdraw, with protocol smart contracts designed for 1 iUSD : 1 AUSD convertibility. Initia's Bridge converts withdrawn iUSD into AUSD, bridges it through LayerZero to Ethereum, and swaps it into USDC. Reserve-related revenue may support ecosystem incentives, development, grants, and other programs; holding iUSD does not entitle holders to reserve yield. Agora retains administrative freeze controls over underlying AUSD.

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: Initia transaction B56AAED7EA34A4F8455FB26961BCB3EDF2493AB8E08F99058BEC21995C4E1FB9 emitted Object::CreateEvent and CoinCreatedEvent for the exact tracked iUSD metadata object at block 12,373,542 on January 19, 2026. The official vault resources establish a 1:1 AUSD-backed wrapper, so the inherited fiat-cash archetype is retained.

notices.title: New chain, no published proof-of-reserves for the wrapper
notices.message: iUSD lives on Initia, a recently launched Move-based Cosmos L1 with limited operational history. Initia has not yet published a dedicated transparency feed for the AUSD-backed iUSD wrapper; reserve trust currently inherits from Agora's published AUSD attestations plus the LayerZero bridge endpoint. Redemption to USD ultimately routes back through the AUSD bridge to Agora.
